summary: Frontend-only check of the Upload PDF dialog file-picker fix (Super Admin > BITSAT > Mock Tests > Upload PDF). Ran in local Playwright against the preview frontend, with /api sent to the isolated bridge (127.0.0.1:8770, disposable DB) and the owner cookies. Tested desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 with touch. 87 checks ran, 80 passed. The 7 failures are 2 mistakes in my own test script, 4 hits on the shared dialog close X (16x16 px), and 1 check that looked in the wrong place. Everything the owner asked for works: the dialog opens in 0.11 s on desktop and 0.51 s on mobile; each of the 3 PDF boxes shows a red 'PDF chuniye' button; every button and the Main box text open the native file chooser by click and by tap; a chosen file shows its name and size, the box turns green (has-file), the button changes to 'Badlo' and an X appears that clears the file; choosing 2 files shows the batch list and 'Sab hatao' clears it; Cancel closes the dialog; 'Roko' shows while uploading. Desktop full upload of two_mocks.pdf took 0.29 s: the dialog closed, the success toast showed and Mock 1 and Mock 2 (two_mocks) appeared in the Mocks list. Questions + answer key merge upload took 0.45 s and closed with the success toast. No 4xx/5xx and no console errors.

ui_bugs.component: Shared Dialog close X (top-right of Upload dialog)
ui_bugs.issue: The tap target is only 16x16 px, below the 44 px rule. It is easy to miss on a phone. This is not part of this fix and probably comes from the shared ui/dialog.

issues: The Main PDF hint wraps to 4 lines in a narrow column next to the button. It is readable and nothing overlaps, but it is dense.

action_items: Optional: make the shared dialog close X at least 44x44 px (padding or min-size on [data-testid=dialog-close]).
critical_code_review_comments: PdfBox: the label htmlFor plus the hidden input (pointer-events:none, clip) plus the button calling ref.click() is a sound pattern. On Android/iOS, input.click() runs inside the user's tap, so the picker opens.
The onChange handler clears e.target.value, so picking the same file again after removing it still fires the change event. Good.

The 'PDF chuniye' button's background is a gradient (computed background-color is transparent and the text is white). It looks red in the screenshots. If the gradient fails to load, white text would sit on a transparent background; a solid fallback colour would cover this. Low risk.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (80/87 raw checks; the 7 failures are 2 script mistakes, 4 hits on the shared close-X size issue and 1 check of the wrong panel)

Script failures to ignore: 'picked: ... PDF chuniye' fails because the button correctly reads 'Badlo' after a pick; 'uploads panel shows new row' fails because [data-testid=type-uploads] was empty, though the new mocks show in the Mocks list. A mobile full upload was not run in this script; ui_upload_repro223.py covers it. Production jeelive.ai could not be reached, so only the preview was checked.
rca of the issue: Before the fix, a full-box invisible <input type=file> overlay was the only way to pick a file. On some phones and browsers the tap did not reliably reach the overlay, and there was no visible button to use instead. Fix: a visible 'PDF chuniye' button and the label text both open a visually hidden input. This was confirmed with page.expect_file_chooser on desktop click and mobile tap for all 3 boxes.
